supplied_pdf_findings: EBOOK SỔ TAY LÝ THUYẾT VẬT LÝ 10 11 12, IPCLASS contains a genuine Grade-11 magnetic-induction section: rendered pages corresponding to printed pages 78-81 cover magnetic flux, flux units, electromagnetic induction, Lenz law and Faraday law; later pages cover AC generation and Foucault currents.
The supplied Grade-11 map/formula/current-electricity ebooks do not provide a dedicated Chapter VII electromagnetic-induction corpus in their visible Grade-11 tables of contents.

The inspected magnetic-induction segment of the IPCLASS theory handbook does not provide the self-inductance/inductor-energy treatment used by lesson 04; that material was therefore verified independently rather than attributed to the PDF.
No BT-Chương I-IV source was treated as a Chapter VII exercise bank because text scans did not locate a corresponding Faraday/Lenz/self-induction section.
